scope: Focused November 21–23 review of the incoming House, executive oversight, Iran funding, Nvidia and cybersecurity leadership, with checks on court, military and election outcomes. Full donor, organizer, trade and immigration implementation coverage remains incomplete.
summary: Nvidia’s board restored Jensen Huang as chief executive after receiving input from senior U.S. officials. Trump separately ordered agencies to coordinate contractors’ replies to Congress. Incoming House Democrats gained room to act after Virginia Foxx conceded, and senators are discussing whether to tie new Pentagon funds to limits on Iran operations. The Iran funding terms and changes to military orders remain open. The Justice Department’s Supreme Court request on Venezuelan protections was withdrawn on November 19. Follow-up is open on New Iran military orders, Venezuela election timetable, Alaska election certification, Lisa Cook hearing and litigation, Massie’s Epstein records bill and Drew Lynch’s response, Implementation of Trump’s announced trade terms, Army’s planned Iowa disposal and Ueland and LoSapio confirmation. No new comparable Republican primary poll or organizer commitments were verified.
